resumo: In the first weeks high contrast draws more attention than colour. A sheet of paper with black and white stripes, moved slowly, buys minutes of fascination and wonderful faces.

secoes.texto: In the first months, sight still tells strong differences of light and dark apart better than soft colours. High-contrast shapes hold attention for longer, and that is what makes the game interesting to her rather than a chore.

secoes.titulo: What you can make at home, today
itens: Draw thick stripes, spirals and targets with a black pen on a white sheet. One sheet per drawing.
Fix a sheet to the side of the cot or on the floor, at the height she looks.
A black and white chequerboard works very well, and you can draw one in two minutes.
What already exists counts too: a striped shirt, the dark skirting board against the pale wall.

secoes.texto: For as long as she is interested, and not a minute beyond. Turning her face away is an answer, not a refusal. One to two minutes at a time, a few times a day, is the format that works.
Film fifteen seconds of her eyes following the drawing, with the paper visible in the frame. It is a video that ages very well, because it shows attention being born.
